banner.title: paperless-ngx
banner.tagline: Ingests scanned documents from an inbox, OCRs them into a searchable archive, and keeps the originals on a backed-up media claim.

art.about: a document management pipeline that ingests scanned pages, runs OCR and archives the originals
art.title: How paperless-ngx ingests a scan

explainer.title: From the inbox to an archive, originals kept

steps.title: Secret
steps.text: ExternalSecret paperless-ngx-secret fills the admin login, the secret key and the database login from 1Password items paperless-ngx and cloudnative-pg.
steps.scene: a key emerging from a vault

steps.title: Database
steps.text: The cnpg-database component creates role and database paperless on postgres-18. init-db waits for them.
steps.scene: a database cylinder with a padlock

steps.title: Consume
steps.text: The consume claim is polled every 60 seconds, recursively. Subfolder names become tags.

steps.title: OCR
steps.text: Two task workers OCR each file in English. The Dragonfly cache holds the task queue, so a restart drops queued tasks.
steps.scene: a page with highlighted text lines

steps.title: Archive
steps.text: Originals and archived PDFs go to the media claim, which kopiur backs up. The consume inbox is deliberately not backed up.
